name: Grilled Scallop Tacos with Wilted Cabbage, Guacamole & Pineapple Salsa

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
3 limes
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ small heads red cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados. Scoop out into a medium bowl and mash with a fork.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the avocado.
Juice half of the limes into the bowl with the avocado; add salt, stir to combine the guacamole, and set aside. (Reserve remaining limes for the salsa.)
Cut off skin from pineapples, core, and small dice. Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; place both in another medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the pineapple and bell pepper.
Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl.
Juice remaining limes into the bowl; add salt, stir to combine the pineapple salsa, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin strips.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add cabbage and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Transfer cabbage to a large plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan for the next step).
While the cabbage is cooking, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on another plate; rub with oil and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sea scallops
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches if necessary, add scallops in a single layer; cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the cabbage.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, spread tortillas with guacamole and top with scallops (cutting them in half if necessary); garnish with wilted cabbage and pineapple salsa. Enjoy!
